integrity: Complete symbolic argument is accompanied by exact finite enumeration; such enumeration does not prove the universal statement; originality remains subject to external historical verification.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonzero associative unital rings under independent uniform sampling; comparison is with a canonical commutative shadow and detects commutativity of the semisimple quotient, not of the original ring; published scalar nilpotent-product formulas and matrix counts are antecedents.
title: Nilpotent-product partner profiles and a strict commutative-shadow convex-order gap
